home.description: ZecHub nye hehenaƒe si nutoa me tɔwo kplɔna na Zcash cryptocurrency (ZEC). Zcash nye dijitaal ga si naa censorship tsitretsitsi, dedienɔnɔ & ame ŋutɔ ƒe fexexe. Zcash Blockchain zãa zk-snarks siwo de ŋgɔ ŋutɔ siwo ‘woate ŋu aɖo kpe edzi’ siwo mehiã be woawɔ ɖoɖo si dzi woka ɖo o le NU5 network ƒe tɔtrɔ le ƒe 2022 me megbe.

whatIsZcash.title: Nukae nye Zcash?
whatIsZcash.description: Enye agbalẽ gã si woate ŋu azã le mɔ gbadza nu, si nye blockchain ledger si me sidzedze zero-sidzedze ƒe kpeɖodziɖoɖo deŋgɔ aɖe le. Ebi ɖe adzamenyawo gbɔ kpɔkpɔ ƒe ɖoɖo si de ŋgɔ wu nana me to eƒe kpeɖodziɖoɖo si kpɔa asitsatsa ŋuti nyatakakawo ƒe nya ɣaɣlawo ta dzi. Le eƒe taɖodzinu vevitɔ me la, Zcash nye ame ŋutɔ ƒe nyatakakawo ƒe amesinɔnɔ si wotsɔna naa ame bubuwo mɔɖeɖe manɔmee ne wole asitsadɔwo wɔm.

exchanges.Near-intents: Nuwo ɖɔliɖɔli kabakaba kple NEAR ƒe kpekpeɖeŋu. Wɔ deposits, dzra, swap siwo dometɔ aɖewoe nye TRUMP, MELANIA, BERA kple meme xɔŋkɔwo
exchanges.Nativeswap: Native Cross-Chain Trading Mɔxenuwo Manɔmee to Maya ƒe Ðoɖowɔɖi dzi. Asitsatsa tẽ le kɔsɔkɔsɔ me tɔdzisasrãwo alo dzesi siwo woxatsa manɔmee - se vivi na dɔwɔƒewo ƒe fe suewo kple nunɔamesiwo dzi kpɔkpɔ bliboe.
exchanges.Firo DEX: Decentralized swaps siwo ŋu kakaɖedzi mele o siwo zãa atɔm swaps kple FiroDEX!.
exchanges.LeoDEX: A crosschain crypto ɖɔliɖɔli ƒe ŋgɔdonya na Maya Protocol, Thorchain, ChainFlip kple Rango. BTC, ETH, RUNE, DASH, LTC & Bubuwo
exchanges.Bison Wallet: Asitsatsa crypto hati-ɖe-hati. Asitsafe aɖeke meli o. KYC aɖeke meli o.
exchanges.THORSwap: Cross-chain DEX si ŋu THORChain le ŋusẽ ɖo, si na be woate ŋu awɔ native swaps le Bitcoin, Ethereum, kple nunɔamesi gã bubuwo dome dzesi siwo woxatsa manɔmee.
exchanges.Router Protocol: Cross-kɔsɔkɔsɔ liquidity transport layer si ɖea mɔ na seamless nunɔamesiwo kple nyatakakawo ƒe asitɔtrɔ le blockchains geɖe dome.
exchanges.Peer: Hatiwo ƒe asitɔtrɔ le teƒe ɖeka si na be woate ŋu awɔ crypto asitsatsa tẽ kple adzamenyawo kple ezãlawo ƒe dziɖuɖu si nyo wu.
exchanges.RocketX: Hybrid DEX aggregator si naa cross-chain swaps le blockchains geɖe me kple mɔfiame nyuitɔ kekeake kple hoʋiʋli ƒe agbɔsɔsɔme.
exchanges.THORChain: Decentralized Layer 1 ƒe atitsoga-kɔsɔkɔsɔ ƒe asitɔtrɔ. Trɔ asi le dzɔdzɔme nunɔamesiwo abe ZEC, BTC, kple ETH ene tẽ tɔdzisasrãwo, dzesi siwo woxatsa, alo domenɔlawo manɔmee.
exchanges.Loofta: Non-custodial ame ŋutɔ ƒe fexexe kple swap platform. Ðo crypto ɖa eye nàxɔe le adzame le kɔsɔkɔsɔwo katã me, eye Zcash nye nyaa gbɔ kpɔkpɔ ƒe ƒuƒoƒo na ganyawo ƒe adzamenyawo si wodo ɖe ŋgɔ.
